hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GELDANAMYCIN was a strong hit in SW-620 (joint 0.95, synergy 4.1, inhibition 86) and DLD1 (joint 0.52). No provided source links HSP90 inhibition to PI3K/mTOR blockade, so the mechanism is general pharmacology. PIK3CA lesions are not a validated predictor: the SW-620 hit is a PIK3CA-wild-type line (KRAS G12V, TP53 mutant). Of the listed candidates, only HCT116, RKO and SK-OV-3 (H1047R) and UWB1289 have PIK3CA lesions in the provided table. PMID:19850405 is not in the provided evidence.
hypotheses.rationale: BEZ-235 blocks PI3K/mTOR and HSP90 inhibition destabilizes client kinases (HSP90 client biology from PMID:19850405). Dual blockade should remove both the pathway and its compensatory feedback (e.g. AKT/RTK re-activation after PI3K/mTOR inhibition, which is general pharmacology and not from a provided source). The selected lines carry PIK3CA H1047R/E545K mutations or PIK3CA amplification (T-47D, OCUBM, HCT116, RKO, SK-OV-3, NCI-H460, CAOV3, UWB1289). The best result so far for this pair is DLD1 with synergy 3.8 and inhibition 67, a strong joint score of 0.52. DLD1 is not on the shortlist and its genotype is not given here, so the link is indirect. The PMIDs below are about the individual drugs, not this combination, so the evidence is thin.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GELDANAMYCIN is active in BRAF V600E A2058 (joint 0.79), but HCT116 (0.28) and RKO (0.27) also respond, so BRAF status is not the determinant. Treat BRAF dependence as unsupported and do not use it to pick lines. A375 is only weakly supported from the data shown, and UACC62, HT144 and ES2 are untested for this pair.
hypotheses.rationale: PMID:19850405 notes HSP90 inhibition is active in melanoma and that oncogenic BRAF mutants are HSP90 clients. These lines carry BRAF V600E. A2058 and UACC62 also have PTEN loss, which makes them dependent on PI3K/mTOR, so BEZ-235 should add to the HSP90 effect. Support is limited to the geldanamycin review, and the combination itself is untested in these lines.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GELDANAMYCIN gives mixed joint scores in KRAS-mutant lines: SW-620 (G12V) 0.22, HCT116 (G13D) 0.18, A427 (G12D) 0.06. A KRAS-based mechanism is not supported, as KRAS-mutant lines rank below BRAF-mutant lines and PIK3CA status and KRAS status do not separate the results. The autophagy-feedback rationale from PMID:37677845 involves a different partner (Lys05) and does not establish an HSP90 effect. Untested: NCIH2122, NCI-H460, SW837.
hypotheses.rationale: PMID:37677845 shows that dactolisib in KRAS-mutant A549 cells induces autophagy as a resistance mechanism, which a second agent can overcome. HSP90 inhibition destabilizes multiple survival kinases and may play a similar role. The KRAS-mutant lines on the shortlist are A427, NCIH2122, NCI-H460, SW-620, SW837 and HCT116. The cited paper used an autophagy inhibitor, not an HSP90 inhibitor, so this is an extrapolation.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + MK-8669 shows a high synergy score but weak inhibition in MDAMB436 (joint -0.08), which may reflect redundant mTOR targeting. Test in one more line before deprioritizing; this is one observation and not a general conclusion.
hypotheses.rationale: BEZ-235 is a dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor and MK-8669 (ridaforolimus) is an mTOR inhibitor (PMID:20945947), so they overlap on mTOR. The shortlist predictions are negative (pred_mean about -0.19 to -0.27) with high uncertainty (std about 1.0). This is a negative or deprioritization hypothesis. Combining two inhibitors of the same target seldom gives more-than-additive effects, which is general pharmacology and not from a provided source.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB is predicted by the model to have a low joint score, but this prediction is uncertain and no data exist for the pair. Dinaciclib is a broad CDK inhibitor, so the pair could give high inhibition with limited excess over additivity. Deprioritize it only on the basis of the model prediction, and do not infer it from other dinaciclib results.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts strongly negative joint score for this pair (pred_mean about -0.83 to -0.92, std about 1.4). The only dinaciclib result so far was poor (CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE + DINACICLIB in MDAMB436 had synergy -41 and joint -2.7), so these experiments should be deprioritized. Dinaciclib's CDK1/2/5/9 inhibition (PMID:37104883 covers its CDK3 binding) is broadly cytotoxic, which may produce high inhibition but little excess over additivity. That interpretation is speculative.

hypotheses.statement: DINACICLIB + MK-8669 may give a high joint score in PI3K-pathway-activated lines (A2058, UACC62, MDAMB436, T-47D), as an untested mechanistic idea. The only support is general pharmacology (mTORC1 and CDK9 both lowering short-lived survival proteins such as MCL1), and the model predicts strongly negative scores. The BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB result in MDAMB436 is related but not direct evidence.
hypotheses.rationale: General pharmacology, not from a provided source: mTORC1 inhibition lowers cap-dependent translation of short-lived survival proteins such as MCL1 and cyclin D1. Dinaciclib's CDK9 inhibition suppresses transcription of the same proteins, so the two agents could converge on loss of MCL1 and cell-cycle arrest through CDK1/2 inhibition. Dinaciclib's CDK2 and CDK3 binding is described in PMID:37104883, which concerns the drug alone. PTEN loss in A2058 and UACC62, PIK3R1 loss in MDAMB436 and PIK3CA H1047R in T-47D should make these lines dependent on mTOR. Evidence for the combination is absent. The only related result so far is BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB in MDAMB436, which gave joint 0.50 and supports dinaciclib combining well with PI3K/mTOR blockade in that line. Rapalogs can also trigger feedback AKT activation, so the benefit is uncertain.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB gave synergy 3.0 and joint 0.50 in MDAMB436 (reported). The pair is untested in other lines, and the CDK9 feedback rationale is general pharmacology.
hypotheses.rationale: The same pair gave synergy 3.0 and inhibition 59.5, a joint score of 0.50, in MDAMB436. That makes it the second-best joint result so far, so the pair is not clearly poor. Dinaciclib's CDK9 inhibition may block the transcriptional feedback that follows PI3K/mTOR inhibition. This is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. The shortlist lines with PIK3CA mutation or amplification are the best place to test it. The evidence is a single result in a different line, so it is thin.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE was positive in LNCAP (about 0.78) and is untested in A2058, UACC62 and A375. The rationale is general pharmacology. PTEN status of A2058 and UACC62 is not in the provided table. PMID:39992316 is not in the provided evidence.
hypotheses.rationale: General pharmacology, not from a provided source: gemcitabine causes replication stress through RNR and polymerase inhibition, and PI3K/AKT signalling supports DNA damage tolerance, so PI3K/mTOR blockade could sensitize cells. A2058 and UACC62 carry PTEN loss, which should raise PI3K dependence. A375 lacks PTEN loss but carries CDKN2A loss, which weakens the G1 checkpoint and may increase reliance on replication-stress tolerance. Dactolisib combined with a cytotoxic drug was shown to be synergistic with cisplatin in PMID:39992316, though that work used nanoparticle delivery and not gemcitabine.

hypotheses.statement: AZD1775 + BEZ-235 gave moderate inhibition in ES2 (synergy 4.8, inhibition 67) and UACC62 (synergy 4.3, inhibition 63) but no top joint score. There is no evidence for TP53 dependence in the provided material. TP53-mutant lines (MDAMB436, OV90, VCAP) could be tested against a TP53-wild-type contrast, but expect modest effects.
hypotheses.rationale: PMID:38519399 describes WEE1 inhibition by adavosertib as synthetically lethal in p53-mutated cancer, because the G1 checkpoint is lost and cells depend on the G2/M checkpoint. The lines chosen carry TP53 mutations (MDAMB436 E204fs, ES2 S241F, OV90 S215R, VCAP R248W, A2058 V274F). UACC62 is included for its PTEN loss and is not TP53-mutant in the panel. PI3K/mTOR inhibition by BEZ-235 should add to this, as PI3K/mTOR inhibition may impair DNA damage repair. That last step is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. The combination itself is untested here.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + MK-2206 was a positive hit in LNCAP (joint about 0.78-0.90; PTEN K6fs*4, PIK3R1 R639*) and may be only additive since BEZ-235 already suppresses AKT. A2058 is untested and its PTEN status is not in the provided table. The rationale is general pharmacology.
hypotheses.rationale: A2058 has PTEN L112Q and V175fs*3, so it should depend on AKT signalling. Combining a PI3K/mTOR inhibitor with an AKT inhibitor can close feedback loops, which is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. BEZ-235 already suppresses AKT activation, so the benefit may be only additive. This is a weakly supported hypothesis with a single test line.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE gave a positive joint score in LNCAP (0.35, synergy 6.8, inhibition 77), lower than A2058 (0.87). The PTEN-null background is consistent with PI3K/AKT-dependent tolerance of replication stress, but this is one line and the mechanism is untested.
hypotheses.rationale: LNCAP carries PTEN K6fs*4 and PIK3R1 R639*, so it should depend on PI3K/AKT signalling, and it also has ATM Q912*, which may weaken the DNA damage response. The shortlist model predicts this pair as the best in LNCAP (pred_mean 0.41, std 0.47, the tightest in the list). The result for this pair in A2058 (joint 0.84, the best so far) supports the pair but is in a different line. The mechanistic link to PI3K dependence is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. No provided paper tests gemcitabine with dactolisib, so the evidence is thin.

hypotheses.statement: AZD1775 + BEZ-235 gave only modest joint scores in A2058, ES2 and UACC62, and A2058 is not clearly better than the other lines. This does not support a TP53-dependence mechanism.
hypotheses.rationale: A2058 is TP53 V274F-mutant, so it lacks a G1 checkpoint and depends on WEE1-controlled G2/M arrest. PTEN loss makes it PI3K/mTOR-dependent. Results so far: AZD1775 + BEZ-235 gave synergy 4.8 and inhibition 67 in ES2, and synergy 4.3 and inhibition 63 in UACC62. A2058 itself is untested for this pair. The p53-dependence idea is only general pharmacology here and is not cited. The evidence is moderate and indirect.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + DOXORUBICIN in A2058 is untested and is a low-confidence test. The analogy to BEZ-235 + gemcitabine is not supported by A2058 data in the visible results. No provided source tests the pair.
hypotheses.rationale: In A2058 the best results so far are BEZ-235 with gemcitabine (a DNA-damaging antimetabolite, joint 0.84), geldanamycin and MK-2206, so BEZ-235 pairs well with DNA-damaging or stress-inducing agents in this line. Doxorubicin is a DNA-damaging topoisomerase II inhibitor and so resembles gemcitabine in effect. The model ranks it the top BEZ-235 pair in A2058 after AZD1775. This is a similarity argument and no cited source tests the pair directly.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + 5-FU in A2058 is an untested analogy to BEZ-235 + gemcitabine. The gemcitabine A2058 result is not visible in the table, and 5-FU acts through a different target (thymidylate synthase).
hypotheses.rationale: Gemcitabine, a pyrimidine analogue like 5-FU, gave the highest joint score so far with BEZ-235 in A2058 (0.84). 5-FU also stresses DNA synthesis, via thymidylate synthase inhibition. The model gives a moderately positive, fairly confident prediction. The inference rests on drug similarity and is not from a provided source.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + PD325901 in A2058 is untested. A2058 genotype is not provided here, so dual MAPK and PI3K/mTOR blockade is general pharmacology only. Pathway attribution would need a contrast line.
hypotheses.rationale: A2058 has both BRAF V600E and MAP2K1 P124S (MAPK pathway activation) and PTEN L112Q and V175fs*3 (PI3K pathway activation). Blocking MEK together with PI3K/mTOR is a general pharmacology rationale for avoiding compensatory pathway activation and is not from a provided source. The model predicts 0.29 with std 0.62. The pair is untested, so the evidence is thin.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is active in PIK3CA-mutant T-47D (joint 0.82), PTEN-null A2058 (0.89), and also in KRAS-mutant NCIH2122 (0.35) and PTEN-null LNCAP (0.33), so PIK3CA mutation is not required and the effect looks broad. Test other PIK3CA-activated lines (CAOV3, UWB1289, OCUBM, SK-OV-3) and PTEN-intact PIK3CA-wild-type contrasts.
hypotheses.rationale: General pharmacology, not from a provided source: gemcitabine causes replication stress, and PI3K/AKT signalling supports tolerance of that stress. PI3K/mTOR blockade should therefore sensitize cells. The chosen lines carry PIK3CA H1047R (T-47D, OCUBM, SK-OV-3) or PIK3CA amplification (CAOV3, UWB1289, T-47D). The model predicts joint scores of 0.52-0.63 with low uncertainty (std 0.43-0.50) for these pairs, the highest and tightest predictions on the shortlist. The best result so far for this pair, in A2058 (joint 0.87), is PIK3CA wild-type but PTEN-null. That supports pathway dependence in general but not PIK3CA mutation specifically. PMID:39992316 shows dactolisib synergizing with cisplatin, a DNA-damaging agent, but it used nanoparticle delivery and not gemcitabine, so the evidence is indirect.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is strongly positive in A2058 (joint 0.69) and T-47D (0.65), and reported modest in NCIH2122 and LNCAP, which are not visible in the table. T-47D is PIK3CA-mutant, so the effect is not tied to PTEN loss. It is below AZD1775 + GEMCITABINE. Model predictions are not evidence.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts pred_mean 0.4-0.6 with std about 0.45-0.5 for nearly all BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE experiments, well above other BEZ-235 pairs. Results so far agree: A2058 gave joint 0.87 and LNCAP 0.35, both positive. This pair is a sound default for the next round. Lines on the shortlist with the weakest predictions (NCI-H460 0.40, NCIH2122 0.42) can serve as a contrast.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + MK-2206 was positive in T-47D (0.87), SK-OV-3 (0.52), A2058 (0.35) and MDAMB436 (0.24), all PI3K-pathway-altered lines. Test OV90, CAOV3 and OVCAR3. Confidence is moderate, since BEZ-235 already blocks AKT and the synergy may partly reflect additivity.
hypotheses.rationale: OV90 carries AKT2 amplification, T-47D PIK3CA H1047R and amplification, CAOV3 PIK3CA and PIK3CB amplification, and MDAMB436 PIK3R1 loss. All of these are pathway-activating changes that should raise reliance on AKT, so a vertical PI3K/mTOR plus AKT block may remove feedback reactivation. The pair was strong in SK-OV-3 (synergy 12.6, joint 0.76) and A2058 (synergy 10.9), both PI3K-activated. PMID:37097377 reports activity of AKT, mTOR and dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitors in melanoma cells, which is indirect support. Predictions are only 0.2-0.3 with std about 0.8, so confidence is low. BEZ-235 already blocks AKT activation, so the benefit may be only additive.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + CARBOPLATIN and + OXALIPLATIN are untested and low priority on weak model predictions. No provided source supports or excludes these platinum pairs.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts negative joint scores with very high uncertainty for BEZ-235 + CARBOPLATIN in A2058, SK-OV-3, OVCAR3 and OCUBM, and for BEZ-235 + OXALIPLATIN in A2058. PMID:39992316 shows synergy of dactolisib with cisplatin in a nanoparticle formulation, so a platinum partner is not excluded in principle, but that is a different delivery format and no data here test it. Gemcitabine, the other DNA-damaging partner, scores much better with BEZ-235, so the platinum pairs are a lower-priority use of experiments.

hypotheses.statement: DINACICLIB + OXALIPLATIN, CARBOPLATIN + DINACICLIB and DINACICLIB + ZOLINZA are predicted to score poorly in T-47D, MDAMB436 and SK-OV-3, but the predictions are very uncertain (std about 1.7). The only observed dinaciclib-cytotoxic pair, CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE + DINACICLIB in MDAMB436, scored -3.74, which gives limited support for deprioritizing cytotoxic partners.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts pred_mean of -1.7 for DINACICLIB with CARBOPLATIN or OXALIPLATIN and -1.34 for DINACICLIB with ZOLINZA, with std about 1.7. The one dinaciclib pair with a cytotoxic partner so far, CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE + DINACICLIB in MDAMB436, was the worst in the dataset (joint -3.7). PMID:37428466 shows CDK1 inhibition restores oxaliplatin sensitivity in colorectal cancer, which argues for dinaciclib plus oxaliplatin, but that study was in colorectal cells and the shortlist test is in breast T-47D. Dinaciclib's strong single-agent effect may leave little room for excess over additivity. That last point is general pharmacology and not from a provided source.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + ZOLINZA has a visible LNCAP hit (joint about 0.78-0.86). T-47D and OCUBM are untested candidates on general pharmacology. Neither has genotype in the provided table, so the PIK3CA claim is unverified. No provided source tests the pair.
hypotheses.rationale: T-47D (PIK3CA H1047R, PIK3CA amplified) and OCUBM (PIK3CA H1047R) are PI3K-pathway driven. HDAC inhibition can lower expression of survival and RTK-feedback genes that are re-engaged after PI3K/mTOR blockade. This is general pharmacology, not from a provided source. The observed A2058 result (joint 0.48) is in a PIK3CA-wild-type, PTEN-null line, so it supports the pair but does not test the PIK3CA argument. No provided paper tests this combination, so the evidence is thin.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + MK-2206 was strong in T-47D (joint 0.69) and positive in SK-OV-3 (0.42). UWB1289 (PIK3CA amplified, NF1 loss) is untested. BEZ-235 already suppresses AKT, so effects may be additive.
hypotheses.rationale: UWB1289 has PIK3CA amplification and NF1 loss, which activates RAS/PI3K signalling and should raise reliance on the PI3K/AKT axis. Vertical PI3K/mTOR plus AKT blockade can limit feedback reactivation, which is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. The model gives a tight prediction (std 0.34), the tightest on the shortlist for this pair. BEZ-235 already suppresses AKT, so the effect may be only additive. The observed T-47D result (joint 0.87) and SK-OV-3 and A2058 results support the pair across PI3K-activated lines, but UWB1289 itself is untested.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is positive in A2058 (0.89), T-47D (0.82), NCIH2122 (0.35) and LNCAP (0.33), so activity looks broad across genotypes. The predictions for OCUBM, MSTO, A375 and VCAP rest only on a model and should be tested, with no assumption that the effect extends to them.
hypotheses.rationale: BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE is the strongest pair so far (A2058 joint 0.89, T-47D 0.82, NCIH2122 0.35, LNCAP 0.33), spanning breast, skin, lung and prostate lines. The model predicts positive, tightly bounded scores (std 0.35-0.39) for OCUBM, MSTO, A375 and VCAP. The observed hits include PTEN-null, PIK3CA-mutant and KRAS-mutant lines, so the effect looks broad and not tied to one genotype. PMID:39992316 shows dactolisib synergizing with the DNA-damaging agent cisplatin, but in a nanoparticle format and not with gemcitabine, so it is indirect support. Evidence for these specific lines is only the model prediction.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + PD325901 reportedly gave high synergy in A2058 (13.2) with modest joint (~0.26-0.31), not visible in the shown table. T-47D and OCUBM are untested, and effects there are expected to be modest since neither carries MAPK-activating mutations. The compensatory ERK argument is general pharmacology.
hypotheses.rationale: The pair gave high synergy in A2058 (13.2, joint 0.31), a line with both MAPK and PI3K activation. In PIK3CA-mutant breast lines, PI3K/mTOR inhibition can lead to compensatory ERK activation, and MEK blockade would counter it. This is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. PMID:22091388 reports that BEZ-235 was effective in lung lines with RTK pathway activation, which is indirect support only. Neither line has MAPK-activating mutations in the panel, so the benefit may be modest.

hypotheses.statement: AZD1775 + BEZ-235 has no visible observed data and is a low-confidence contrast test. PMID:38519399 concerns adavosertib alone in gallbladder cancer and does not test this pair. MDAMB436 and OVCAR3 are TP53-mutant in the provided table; the other lines' status is unverified.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts low means with high uncertainty for this pair in all eight shortlist lines, including TP53-mutant lines (MDAMB436, OVCAR3, SW-620, LNCAP) that would be expected to depend on WEE1. PMID:38519399 describes WEE1 inhibition as synthetically lethal in p53-mutated cancer, but this is for adavosertib alone in gallbladder cancer. The model gives no obvious TP53 or PIK3CA separation among the lines, so the best use of this pair is as a contrast against the stronger BEZ-235 partners.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + DINACICLIB has already been tested in A2058, with a modest positive joint score of 0.24 (synergy 4.3, inhibition 71). The model's prediction of a high score is not supported, as 0.24 is modest. T-47D and MDAMB436 also scored positive.
hypotheses.rationale: A2058 has PTEN L112Q and V175fs*3, so it should depend on PI3K/mTOR signalling. PI3K/mTOR blockade lowers translation of short-lived survival proteins, and dinaciclib's CDK9 inhibition suppresses their transcription. That convergence is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. The pair was positive in T-47D and MDAMB436 in the results so far, which is indirect support from different lines. The A2058 prediction is modest, so confidence is low. No provided paper tests this combination.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + ETOPOSIDE is untested and rests on analogy to DNA-damaging partners. The only visible BEZ-235 + gemcitabine hit is in LNCAP (about 0.78), not T-47D or A2058. No provided source tests it.
hypotheses.rationale: BEZ-235 paired strongly with the DNA-damaging antimetabolite gemcitabine in T-47D and A2058. Etoposide is a topoisomerase II inhibitor that also causes DNA damage, so a similar sensitization by PI3K/mTOR blockade is plausible. This is general pharmacology. PMID:39992316 shows dactolisib synergizing with cisplatin, a DNA-damaging agent, but in a nanoparticle format, so it is indirect support only. The model prediction is modestly positive and no data exist for this pair.

hypotheses.statement: AZD1775 + GEMCITABINE in A2058 is predicted to score poorly (pred_mean -1.21, std 1.69). WEE1 inhibition with gemcitabine is a known replication-stress rationale in TP53-mutant cells, but this prediction is uncertain and is not supported by observed data. Deprioritize it relative to BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts strongly negative joint scores for AZD1775 pairs, including with DINACICLIB in all three lines (pred_mean -1.6 to -1.7). Both partners here target cell-cycle and replication-stress checkpoints and may saturate the same vulnerability, so there is little room for excess over additivity. That interpretation is speculative general pharmacology. A2058 is TP53 V274F-mutant, which would favour WEE1 dependence, so the model prediction could be wrong. BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE has observed support in A2058 (joint 0.89) and is the better use of an experiment.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 with BORTEZOMIB or METHOTREXATE or TEMOZOLOMIDE is predicted to be only mildly positive in A2058 and T-47D (pred_mean 0.03-0.07, std 0.65-0.73). Expect these pairs to rank below BEZ-235 + GEMCITABINE and + DINACICLIB. Test one of them only as a low-cost contrast.
hypotheses.rationale: These pairs have the highest predicted means among the shortlist BEZ-235 experiments outside DINACICLIB and ETOPOSIDE. Their stds of 0.65-0.73 are lower than for kinase-inhibitor partners (std 1.0-1.5). Bortezomib, methotrexate and temozolomide are not mechanistically related to the observed hits. Observed top pairs so far involve HSP90, AKT, MEK, HDAC and replication-stress agents. The predictions are weak and this is a statistical call with no observed data for these partners.

hypotheses.statement: BEZ-235 + LAPATINIB, + SORAFENIB and + DASATINIB are low priority on model predictions only. No provided source tests these pairs.
hypotheses.rationale: The model gives the lowest means on the shortlist to BEZ-235 + LAPATINIB (-0.79 in A2058, -0.76 in T-47D), and negative means to SORAFENIB and DASATINIB pairs. A2058 has BRAF V600E and no HER2 or EGFR amplification, so lapatinib has no obvious target there. T-47D carries no ERBB2 amplification in the panel either. Multi-kinase partners may add some PI3K feedback blockade, which is general pharmacology and not from a provided source. PMID:30762245 reports BEZ-235 and dasatinib as topical agents against cutaneous squamous carcinoma, but that is a different tumor type and does not test the pair in these lines, so it is not strong support.

hypotheses.statement: AZD1775 + GEMCITABINE is the top pair in OVCAR3 (joint 1.68) and strong in MDAMB436 (0.98), but failed in LNCAP (about -4.4). TP53 mutation in OVCAR3, MDAMB436, SW837, SW-620 and SK-OV-3 is consistent with the table, so TP53 loss is a plausible but unproven predictor. PMID:38519399 concerns adavosertib alone in gallbladder cancer. PMID:32180106 and PMID:31471286 are not in the provided evidence.
hypotheses.rationale: Gemcitabine inhibits RNR and DNA polymerase and causes replication stress. WEE1 inhibition removes the S-phase and G2/M checkpoint, so cells enter mitosis with damaged DNA. This was reported for MYC-driven medulloblastoma (PMID:32180106) and clinically for pancreatic cancer with radiation (PMID:31471286). PMID:38519399 links WEE1 inhibition to synthetic lethality in p53-mutated cancer. The chosen lines carry TP53 mutations in the panel: ES2 S241F, T-47D L194F, SW-620 P309S/R273H, SW837 R248W, MDAMB436 E204fs, OVCAR3 R248Q and VCAP R248W. The pair's prediction in the shortlist is only about 0.1 with std about 1.2, so the model has little confidence. The literature is in other tumor types and the shortlist lines are untested. This earlier hypothesis H28 predicted a poor score in A2058, but the observed result was the best so far, which shows the model is unreliable for AZD1775 pairs.

hypotheses.statement: AZD1775 + GEMCITABINE should work in PTEN-intact or TP53-wild-type-like lines less well. In the shortlist, lines without a clear TP53 mutation (PA1, MSTO, UWB1289 has TP53 R209fs so excluded) may be weaker contrasts. This is a statistical call: the pair's predictions are positive and nearly uniform across lines, so no line is clearly favored.
hypotheses.rationale: The model predicts pred_mean 0.05-0.14 with std about 1.2 for AZD1775 + GEMCITABINE in nearly all lines. Positive predictions are highest in T-47D (0.14), LNCAP (0.13), ES2 (0.12) and UACC62 (0.11). These means are close to zero, so this is a weak signal. The pair's high result in A2058 (joint 0.94) suggests a real effect in the best case. PA1 and MSTO have no TP53 driver listed in the panel and serve as a contrast for the WEE1-dependence idea (PMID:38519399). The evidence is thin.

The original statement also groups ES2 under melanoma. ES2 is ovarian, and its MAP2K1 D67N mutation may alter its dependence on BRAF.

Keeping the claim as a firm prediction would overstate the evidence.

No experiments on this pair have been run, so a confident low-score prediction is not justified.

PMID:19850405 supports HSP90 client biology but is not in the provided literature excerpts, and PMID:19850405 cannot be verified. The selected mechanism does not predict the results.
